segments.t: But on the first day of the week, at early dawn,
they and some others
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「they and some others」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの句はない

segments.t: came to the tomb,
bringing the spices which they had prepared.
They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.
They entered in, and didn’t find the
Lord Jesus’
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「Lord Jesus’」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない

segments.t: body.
While they were greatly perplexed about this,
behold, two men stood by them in dazzling clothing.
Becoming terrified, they bowed their faces down to the earth.
The men said to them,
segments.note: 「The men」は英語の補い

segments.t: “Why do you seek the living among the dead?
He isn’t here, but is risen.
Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee,
saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men and be crucified, and the third day rise again?”
segments.note: 語順の組み替え（ὅτι δεῖ が英語では Son of Man の後に来る）

segments.t: They remembered his words,
returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven and to all the rest.
Now they were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James.
segments.note: ἡ Ἰακώβου（ヤコブの）を「the mother of James」と展開

segments.t: The other women with them told these things to the apostles.
These words seemed to them to be nonsense, and they didn’t believe them.
But Peter got up and ran to the tomb.
Stooping and looking in, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves,
segments.note: ὀθόνια（亜麻布）を「strips of linen」と訳す

segments.t: and he departed to his home, wondering what had happened.
segments.note: πρὸς αὑτὸν（自分のところへ）を「to his home」と訳す

segments.t: Behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem.
They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.
While they talked and questioned together, Jesus himself came near, and went with them.
But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.
He said to them,
“What are you talking about as you walk,
and are sad?”
segments.note: ἐστάθησαν（立ち止まった）は英語では表に出ない

segments.t: One of them, named Cleopas, answered him,
“Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who doesn’t know the things which have happened there in these days?”
segments.note: παροικεῖς（寄留する）を「stranger」と名詞化

segments.t: He said to them, “What things?”
They said to him,
“The things concerning Jesus the Nazarene,
who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;
and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.
But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel.
Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened.
Also, certain women of our company amazed us, having arrived early at the tomb;
and when they didn’t find his body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.
Some of us went to the tomb
and found it just like the women had said,
but they didn’t see him.”
He said to them,
“Foolish people, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!
Didn’t the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?”
Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.
They came near to the village where they were going, and he acted like he would go further.
They urged him, saying,
“Stay with us, for it is almost evening,
and the day is almost over.”
He went in to stay with them.
When he had sat down at the table with them,
he took the bread and gave thanks.
Breaking it, he gave it to them.
Their eyes were opened and they recognized him; then he vanished out of their sight.
They said to one another,
“Weren’t our hearts burning within us while he spoke to us along the way, and while he opened the Scriptures to us?”
They rose up that very hour, returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and those who were with them,
saying, “The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!”
They related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread.
As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them,
and said to them, “Peace be to you.”
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「and said to them, “Peace be to you.”」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの句はない

segments.t: But they were terrified and filled with fear, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.
He said to them, “Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in your hearts?
See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn’t have flesh and bones, as you see that I have.”
segments.note: αὐτός（本人）を「truly」と訳す

segments.t: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.
While they still didn’t believe for joy, and wondered, he said to them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”
segments.note: βρώσιμον（食べ物）を「anything … to eat」と展開

segments.t: They gave him a piece of a broiled fish
and some honeycomb.
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「and some honeycomb」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの句はない

segments.t: He took them, and ate in front of them.
segments.note: λαβών の目的語は英語では「them」

segments.t: He said to them,
“This is what I told you while I was still with you,
that all things which are written in the law of Moses, the prophets, and the psalms concerning me must be fulfilled.”
segments.note: δεῖ（ねばならない）は英語では末尾に出る

segments.t: Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures.
He said to them, “Thus it is written,
and thus it was necessary
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「and thus it was necessary」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの句はない

segments.t: for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,
and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
segments.note: ἀρξάμενοι（始めて）は「beginning」と訳される

segments.t: You are witnesses of these things.
Behold, I send out the promise of my Father on you.
But wait in the city
of Jerusalem
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「of Jerusalem」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない

segments.t: until you are clothed with power from on high.”
He led them out as far as Bethany, and he lifted up his hands and blessed them.
While he blessed them, he withdrew from them and was carried up into heaven.
They worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,
and were continually in the temple,
praising and
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「praising and」を補う。ギリシャ語本文に αἰνοῦντες はない

segments.t: blessing God.
Amen.
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「Amen」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない
